thread:
alex.release: Quick heads-up — release window in ~2h. Coordinating API/runtime/router/console rollout. Sequence proposal: API -> Runtime -> Router -> Console. Goals: 0-data-loss, staged traffic, clear rollback gates. Anyone object?

peter-api: OK from API side. v1.9.0 built, target image tag redwood/api:v1.9.0. Pin to commit abc123. Canary at 10% for 15m, health checks: 200/latency < 250ms. Will post release notes snippet.

jamie-runtime: runtime v2.3.1 ready. Note: includes kernel switch (atten-optim). If we see KV cache blowups we should auto-fallback to v2.2.x. Suggest adding a 5m warm-up after canary then move traffic. Also need router compatibility check (protocol v2).

lina-router: Router team will be ready. Router target: redwood/router:stable-2026-03. We can accept protocol v2, but if runtime reports increased TLS err rates we'll pin to router-v4.9 and divert traffic. Will keep config flag router.allow_protocol_v2=true for rollout.

alex.release: Good — can everyone paste the exact pin commands we should run from the orchestration playbook so the deploy-runbook has them? Also please confirm rollback triggers (metrics + thresholds).

peter-api: Pin command I used locally:
```
kubectl set image deploy/api api=redwood/api:v1.9.0 -n prod
kubectl annotate deploy/api release-pin=abc123
```
Rollback triggers for API: 1) 5m error rate > 1% across p50/p95; 2) latency p95 > 800ms for 5m; 3) new 5xx spike >= 10/min. Rollback action: kubectl set image ... api=redwood/api:v1.8.4

jamie-runtime: Runtime pin:
```
# pin runtime pool
rwctl pool update runtime-pool --image redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 --pin commit=def456
```
Runtime rollback triggers: sustained OOMs in pods OR KV cache miss rate > 30% and tail latency p99 > 1.5s for 3m. Fallback: rwctl pool update runtime-pool --image redwood/runtime:v2.2.7

lina-router: Router pin (control-plane):
```
helm upgrade router stable-router --set image=redwood/router:stable-2026-03 --namespace infra
kubectl label ns default router-rollout=stable-2026-03
```
Router rollback: increased connection resets > 0.5% for 5m or TLS handshake errors rising. Fallback image: redwood/router:v4.9.

sophie-console: Console team will stay last. Console pin: redwood/console:v3.0.1. We'll only flip after router at 100% and 30m steady state.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: job_id=deploy-2380009112. Sequence: api->runtime->router->console. Canary windows: api=15m, runtime=10m, router=10m, console=15m. Auto-rollback hooks attached.

oncall-mike: Oncall will watch dashboards. My paging rules: page on SLO breach or any rollback action. I'll be around for the window.

alex.release: Two coordination requests: (1) add an explicit fallback route in router config to direct 5% to router-v4.9 if runtime health degrades; (2) add a dynamic traffic hedge: if error budget spent > 30% during canary, hold and notify. Can teams confirm they can implement those quickly?

jamie-runtime: We can emit a health webhook if pool degradation > threshold. Can wire to router via feature flag.

lina-router: We can add the fallback route. Will push a fast patch to route config and feature flag.

peter-api: API will add a temporary retry/backoff tweak for canary traffic to reduce error noise.

alex.release: Nice. Please paste final release-note blurb and rollback steps in the thread once you’re green. I’ll run the cutover. :thumbsup:

peter-api: Release note draft: "API v1.9.0: minor breaking fix for rate-limiter, performance improvements to auth path. Deployed as canary 10% -> staged rollout. Rollback to v1.8.4 if >1% errors or latency regressions."

jamie-runtime: Runtime note: "Runtime v2.3.1: kernel attenuation optimizations for long context. Watch KV miss rate and tail latency. Fallback to v2.2.7 if OOMs or KV miss >30%."

lina-router: Router note: "Router stable-2026-03: protocol v2 support and improved routing rules. Fallback available to v4.9 on TLS or reset regressions."

alex.release: Perfect. I'll kick the deploy in ~5m. Everyone stay alert on #eng-oncall and this thread. If we see anything odd, call the rollback and ping :oncall-mike.

deploy-bot: Starting canary for api (redwood/api:v1.9.0) now. canary_id=canary-2380009112-api

peter-api: Canary traffic live. Logs look clean so far. p95 ~180ms.

jamie-runtime: Runtime pool warm-up in progress, 3/4 nodes reporting ready.

lina-router: Router config patch applied, fallback route created.

oncall-mike: Watching. No alerts currently.

alex.release: Thanks all — will update after runtime canary stabilizes.
